verdict.rationale: Parsec documents its own multi-monitor streaming of up to three monitors, plus virtual monitors, so it covers viewing a multi-display host. Nothing in the evidence shows picking one specific monitor, streaming a single window or app, or switching between displays mid-session. The host-side control over which apps guests may see is a permission feature, not viewer-side selection, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: selecting a specific monitor, single window/app capture, mid-session display switching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: Warp is enhanced with support for pressure sensitive pens and Wacom tablets, 4:4:4 color mode, and multi-monitor support.
